title: Prospective Unordered Legal-Move Pair Transport, Reciprocal Cross-Engine Preference-Boundary Geometry, Orientation-Free Causal Signature Constitution & Fresh Pairwise Mechanism Replication
founding_question: Is the unordered legal-move pair {A,B} a more transportable chess object than engine-specific winner/rival orientation, and do exact search events reproducibly alter that pair edge across engines?

invariance_constitution.quotient: identify pair labels under the two-element permutation group S2: {A,B} is invariant under A<->B
invariance_constitution.prospective_authority: the quotient is frozen before any P14 intervention outcome and cannot retroactively rescue P13
label_swap_invariants: target relation to engine-relative baseline preferred/dispreferred pair member
same-position multi-engine reversal and reciprocal-vs-consensus geometry
invariance_constitution.reopening_rule: canonical UCI pair identity and engine-level orientation are retained so the quotient can be audited or reversed if it erases a live chess distinction

source_freshness.policy: reuse completed July/August provider bytes only as source containers; every P14 target and decoy position must be hash-disjoint from all recoverable P1-P13 positions

fresh_worlds.eligibility: standard legal nonterminal chess; not in check; plies 14-25; 18-48 legal moves; absolute material imbalance <=3 pawns; candidate and decoy hashes disjoint from recoverable P1-P13 corpus hashes

engine_qualification.legal_move_universe: enumerate every legal root move; no tactical prefilter
engine_qualification.shallow_rank: one cold root-restricted equal-node search per legal move; rank by side-to-move engine score with deterministic UCI tiebreak
engine_qualification.shortlist: eight highest shallow-ranked legal moves per engine
engine_qualification.confirmatory_score: two cold root-restricted 30k-node searches for each shortlisted move
engine_qualification.stable_move: both confirmatory scores are non-mate cp scores and exactly equal
engine_qualification.contextual_bestmove: 80k-node shared search after frozen prime/decoy history

unordered_pair_constitution.canonical_pair_id: lexicographically sorted UCI pair joined by ::; lexical A/B is storage only, not scientific orientation
unordered_pair_constitution.engine_support_for_pair: both moves are stable for that engine, absolute isolated cp gap <=50, and the engine's contextual shared-search bestmove is one of the pair
unordered_pair_constitution.pair_admission: at least two engines support the same unordered pair at the same fresh position
pair_selection_order: minimum median absolute isolated cp gap among supporting engines
minimum maximum absolute isolated cp gap among supporting engines

position_geometry.CONSENSUS_ORIENTATION: all active supporting engines prefer the same pair member at baseline
position_geometry.SPLIT_ORIENTATION: active supporting engines include baseline preference for both pair members

root_child_attribution.observer: inherit P13 private nonbehavioral root-child full-position-key observer
root_child_attribution.mapping: root-restricted searchmoves fingerprint for the two frozen pair members maps private ply-1 keys back to legal UCI identity
root_child_attribution.node_allocation_claim: forbidden; semantic-event exposure is not candidate-specific node accounting

exact_target.candidate_membership: target private root-child key must map to one of the two frozen pair members

target_relation.BASELINE_PREFERRED: target maps to the pair member chosen by this engine at baseline
target_relation.BASELINE_DISPREFERRED: target maps to the other frozen pair member

exact_target.selection: lexicographically smallest exact address IDs up to max_targets_per_active_world from baseline trace only
exact_target.intervention: T_ONLY exact semantic-use removal; TT storage/replacement/index/age untouched

orientation_free_effects.EDGE_REVERSAL: baseline pair member becomes the other frozen pair member under T_ONLY
orientation_free_effects.EDGE_PRESERVED: baseline pair member remains root bestmove under T_ONLY
orientation_free_effects.EDGE_TO_THIRD_ESCAPE: T_ONLY selects a legal move outside the frozen pair

same_position_transport.MULTIENGINE_REVERSAL: at least two engines at the same position/pair each show EDGE_REVERSAL for the same semantic transport key
same_position_transport.RECIPROCAL_MULTIENGINE_REVERSAL: MULTIENGINE_REVERSAL and the reversing engines have opposite baseline-preferred pair members
same_position_transport.CONSENSUS_MULTIENGINE_REVERSAL: MULTIENGINE_REVERSAL and the reversing engines share the same baseline-preferred pair member

claim_ceiling: P14 may identify exact-event-sensitive causal reversal of an unordered near-equal legal-move pair edge under frozen engine/history/node budgets.
Same-position multi-engine reversal is a semantic-class transport result, not identity of native event addresses or algorithms.

Reciprocal cross-engine geometry means opposite engine-specific orientations of the same prospectively frozen unordered pair can each be causally reversed; it is not a claim that engines implement the same internal mechanism.
Root-child semantic-event exposure is not per-candidate node allocation.
Engine preference is not objective chess truth, human strategic intent, cognition, or normative move quality.
Raw TT keys remain private intra-run locators.
forbidden: No retrospective relabeling of P13's nine direct flips as P14 evidence.
No post-outcome pair selection or 50 cp threshold tuning.
No selection bonus for observing reciprocal intervention outcomes.
No public raw TT key emission.
No claim of shared internal mechanism merely from semantic transport.
stop_rule: Adjudicate the frozen 24-position/72-engine-world campaign once. If orientation-free transport fails, report the ceiling rather than subdividing the exact-event skeleton after outcomes.
